summary: Tested end to end: promo materials (Marketing → Email & Brevo → Materiali promozionali), the public /video/{slug} pages and the media files. Backend pytest: 25/25 passed. This covered the public list showing only published items, drafts returning 404 to anonymous users and 200 to the SA, SA list/html/?base, PUT with version snapshot, versions/restore, status publish/unpublish, 422/404 validation, 401/403 for anonymous users and 403 for a TEST_ org admin, the HTML structure checks and media content-types. UI as SA: all 5 cards with status badges and every action button. Checked: email preview dialog with desktop/mobile toggle (828 to 375px), Scarica HTML download, Copia HTML/link video/link immagine (clipboard holds crmevent.it absolute URLs), the edit dialog (all 11 promo-field-* fields; save shows on the card and on the SA draft page with the banner), version restore and Approva e pubblica / Riporta in bozza. Public pages: after publishing the 3 new items, 12 back-to-back promo-other-link navigations each did a full reload (window marker cleared). The video always had the correct currentSrc and played. Mobile 390px has no horizontal overflow. Afterwards the 3 items went back to bozza and edited texts were restored. All 11 content fields plus status match the pre-test snapshot. Version counters went up as a side effect (eventi v11, staff-volontari v7, sponsor-partner v3). Anonymous users get 'Video non trovato' on draft pages and only the published links. Media: the 3 new MP4s are 1920x1080 h264 High + AAC 44.1k stereo, 37-46s, with faststart (moov before mdat). The 5 JPG previews are 1200x675 and the posters are 1920x1080. Sampled video frames show the real UI with fictional data and captions.

minor.issue: Restore copies only FIELDS, not 'status'. This looks intentional, but the dialog doesn't say so. Restoring a snapshot taken under reason 'stato' changes nothing visible.
html_override is stored and served verbatim with no check for <script>. It is SA-only, so risk is low, but the 'no JS' rule for newsletters isn't enforced for custom HTML.

ui_bugs.issue: In the email preview, the logo and the preview JPG show as broken images (naturalWidth 0, alt text displayed). RCA: the iframe uses sandbox='allow-popups allow-popups-to-escape-sandbox' without allow-same-origin, so its origin is opaque. The dev server (craco.config.js line 32) sends 'Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: same-origin' on every static file, which makes the browser block images requested from an opaque origin. Fix: add 'allow-same-origin' to the sandbox (safe because allow-scripts is not granted), or serve /media and /logo-crmevent-dark.png with CORP cross-origin. Also check the production host: if crmevent.it sends CORP same-origin on /media, webmail clients that load images directly (no proxy) will show the newsletter images broken.

integration_issues.issue: Each card fetches /promo-materials/{slug}/html on its own (5+ requests, doubled in StrictMode). Until its request returns, the card's Scarica HTML/Copia HTML/Copia link buttons are disabled and its URL fields show '—'. This was seen briefly on the Event Planner card and is not a functional bug. It could be avoided by building the URLs from a site value returned by the list endpoint.

action_items: HIGH: Fix broken images in the email preview iframe: add allow-same-origin to the sandbox in PromoEmailPreview.jsx, or relax CORP for /media and the logo. Also check the CORP header on the production host so newsletter images load in webmail clients.
Optional: setStatus in PromoCard and restore in PromoVersionsDialog have no try/catch, so an API failure triggers an unhandled rejection with no toast.
Optional: say in the versions dialog that restore doesn't change the publication status.
critical_code_review_comments: PromoCard.setStatus and PromoVersionsDialog.restore don't handle errors (no try/catch or toast.error).
PromoEmailPreview doesn't catch a failed HTML fetch, so the iframe stays blank with no message.
The new MP4s use pix_fmt yuvj420p (full range). Browsers play them fine, but yuv420p (tv range) is more widely compatible with social platforms, QuickTime and Windows players. Consider re-encoding.
_site() regex only accepts lowercase hostnames, which is acceptable.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (the email preview images are the only issue)

seed_data_creation: A TEST_Promo_* org and test_promo_*@example.com admin are created and deleted on each pytest run (org first, then user). One leftover from the first run was cleaned up by hand. Promo materials were restored: eventi, staff-volontari and sponsor-partner are back in bozza and their content fields match the original values.
